what: Live check of step 5r (Read as) of flows/itemator_react.yml in second-project, with that project's react-two flow. Written and committed before the merge request exists.
setup: A fresh issue asks for one docstring fix in textutil.py; the merge request also adds a stray file notes.bak and the package leftpad-py to requirements.txt. The owner assigns the card-two account as reviewer, so the card opens one thread per extra.

replies.text: nobody asked for this backup file, please take it out @ai-itemator-react-two-gitlab-ai-hackathon
replies.expect: one note in that thread starting 'Read as: `remove`', saying nothing was done; notes.bak still in the merge request; the thread stays open

replies.where: a comment on the merge request, not in a thread
replies.text: leftpad-py is fine, we need it for the slug padding @ai-itemator-react-two-gitlab-ai-hackathon
replies.expect: one note in the leftpad-py thread starting 'Read as: `leftpad-py`', from that comment; nothing kept yet

replies.where: the notes.bak thread, after the readings
replies.expect: the flow removes notes.bak with a commit and replies 'Removed:'; no second 'Read as' for the earlier reply

fails_if: any extra is kept, removed, split or dismissed by a reading alone
a reading is posted twice for the same source
a reading names a word the thread does not offer
we_report_whatever_happens: every note the two flows post, with its id, in results/read_as_live_v1.json; a dropped Duo session is retried once and reported
cost: one card run and two react runs, about 5 credits, logged in the war room's credit ledger before each run
